name: krs_company_get
description: Polish company or organisation by KRS number (National Court Register, Krajowy Rejestr Sadowy). e.g. {krs:"0000019193"} (PKP S.A.). Returns {found, company:{krs, register, legal_name, legal_form, regon, nip, registration_date, registered_address, website, share_capital, main_activity, status, status_basis, procedures}, data_as_of, source}. Lookup is by KRS number only (the register has no name search); found:false with reason when the number is not registered. No officers or personal data are returned.

register.description: Optional: P = entrepreneurs, S = associations/foundations/public bodies. Default: tries P then S.
